description: Systems: what is opened and saved. A System is a root Component — the solution to the highest-level problem, whose Deployments are the ways to solve it — with the packages beside it: dependencies, such as catalog content, and plug-ins. Where a Component is kept says nothing of who may import it. The System is the one real Instance of its root: every identity starts there. The top Language: it ties the layers together. Extends Mediation.

axioms.about: A System's root and packages are not nested
axioms.formula: all s in System, c in s.packages. no c.parent and no s.root.parent

axioms.about: A System's root is not one of its packages
axioms.formula: all s in System. not s.root in s.packages

axioms.about: Every Component is nested, or is the root or a package of a System
axioms.formula: all c in Component. some c.parent or some c.system or (some s in System. c in s.packages)

axioms.about: An identity starts at a placement in a Deployment of the System's root
axioms.formula: all m in Import, f in m.steps, y in System. no f.previous => f.instance.deployment.component == y.root
